name: abilities-mcp
description: Connect an AI client to a governed Mycelium for WordPress site through MCP.
long_description:
Mycelium Abilities MCP for WordPress is the local bridge between an AI client and Mycelium for WordPress. Mycelium runs on the WordPress site and governs its registered abilities; this bundle runs in the AI-client environment and routes calls to them.

This MCPB bundle uses a WordPress URL, username, and Application Password as its required baseline. For OAuth or multi-site connections, install the CLI and use its OAuth setup commands. The bundle does not add permissions: the WordPress user, Mycelium policy, and OAuth scopes remain authoritative.

site_url.title: WordPress Site URL
site_url.description: Your WordPress site URL, e.g. https://example.com

username.title: WordPress Username
username.description: The WordPress username the AI will act as. Capabilities of this user determine what abilities are available.

app_password.title: Application Password
app_password.description: WordPress Application Password (Users → Profile → Application Passwords). Stored encrypted in your OS keychain.
